about: Measured facts about where a vehicle can spawn on a published level pack. A level pack carries no PlayerStart pose the generator can read, and a hand-written ScenarioSpec's coordinate_frame.origin defaults to the Unreal world origin, so a vehicle starting at (0, 0) lands wherever that origin happens to be. On the levels listed with origin_has_floor false there is nothing under it: the vehicle falls through the world and the autopilot refuses to arm. tools/check_spawn.py (make fly, make campaign) warns about such a spawn and suggests the known start. Start poses are AirSim NED metres relative to the world origin (+z is down).

xfs-level.measured: Held 160 m up for World Partition to stream the terrain in, then dropped: at rest on the ground at NED z = -18.70 at (423, -906). -21.0 is 2.3 m above it. A (0, 0, 0) spawn free-falls at ~8 m/s (phase 5 acceptance F8, OSMO sim-bridge-vio runs). A container stack stands 4 m east of the yard start.

condo-level.measured: An origin spawn free-fell indefinitely (sim-bridge-vio-13: /ground_truth/odom -71.7 m to -1216.4 m at ~9 m/s, x and y 0.000). (0, -20, -2.0) is 2 m above the floor and flies the bedroom loop (scenarios/vio-osmo-condo). The compose stack's Z: 1.3 is 1.3 m BELOW the floor and fell too.
